findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/Module/RingHom.lean:57 `abbrev Module.compHom … See note [reducible non-instances]`; Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/RestrictScalars.lean:111 `Module.restrictScalars … Not an instance … The preferred way of setting this up is [Module R M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower R S M]`; Mathlib/Algebra/Module/LinearMap/Defs.lean:744 `instance : SMul S (M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂)` needs only `[DistribSMul S M₂] [SMulCommClass R₂ S M₂]`, both available for `S := K` via Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Basic.lean:427 `IsScalarTower.to_smulCommClass'`.
findings.fix: Do not register `Module.compHom` globally. Either make `tangentSpace` a semireducible `def` (or `RestrictScalars K κ(0) (ZariskiTangentSpace A.toScheme A.zeroPoint)`) and re-declare the κ(0)- and K-instances on that synonym, or supply `Module K (ZariskiCotangentSpace A.toScheme A.zeroPoint)` with `IsScalarTower K κ(0) _` and let Mathlib's `LinearMap.module` define the K-structure pointwise; drop the then-redundant `isScalarTower_tangentSpace`.
findings.issue: `tangentSpaceModule` registers `Module.compHom` as a global instance on `A.tangentSpace`, which is a chain of `abbrev`s (`tangentSpace` → `ZariskiTangentSpace` → `Module.Dual`) reducing to `ZariskiCotangentSpace →ₗ[κ(0)] κ(0)`. Once the `Algebra K κ(0)` instance at line 183 is in scope, Mathlib's `LinearMap.instSMul` already supplies a (pointwise) `SMul K` on that same type, so the public tangent space has two competing K-action paths that agree only up to non-reducible defeq. `isScalarTower_tangentSpace` (line 216) likewise duplicates `LinearMap.instIsScalarTower`, and `smul_tangentSpace_def` (line 211) states an equation whose LHS may elaborate with the pointwise instance rather than the declared one.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/ResidueField.lean:189-191 `@[simp] residueFieldCongr_refl : X.residueFieldCongr (refl x) = Iso.refl _`; lines 197-199 `@[simp] residueFieldCongr_inv (e : x = y) : (X.residueFieldCongr e).inv = (X.residueFieldCongr e.symm).hom` (matches any `e`).
findings.fix: State all four lemmas without the `residueFieldCongr` factor — the two residue-field types are definitionally equal, which is exactly what the embedded `by rfl` proves, so the equations still typecheck.
findings.issue: The four public normal-form lemmas `zeroResidueFieldIso_hom` (93), `zeroResidueFieldIso_inv` (109), `zeroResidueFieldRingEquiv_apply` (153) and `zeroResidueFieldRingEquiv_symm_apply` (167) state a right-hand side containing a no-op `(A.toScheme.residueFieldCongr (by rfl : A.zeroPoint = A.zeroSection _))` factor. `Scheme.residueFieldCongr_refl` cannot eliminate it (its pattern needs a syntactic `refl`, and `zeroPoint` is a semireducible `def`), so the cast is stuck in every simp output; and `Scheme.residueFieldCongr_inv` does match the `.inv` occurrences, so the advertised RHS of lemmas 109/167 is not the actual simp normal form.

findings.evidence: Line 183-185 `instance (A : AbelianVariety K) : Algebra K …` (no name); line 192-196 `zeroResidueFieldRingEquiv_algebraMap` proves the round trip via `rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]`, the step every consumer would otherwise have to repeat.
findings.fix: Name the instance (e.g. `algebraZeroResidueField`) and add the characterizing lemma `algebraMap K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField …) k = A.zeroResidueFieldRingEquiv.symm k`.
findings.issue: The `Algebra K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (A.toScheme.presheaf.stalk A.zeroPoint))` instance — the load-bearing piece of the whole K-structure — is anonymous (auto-generated, unstable name), unlike every other instance in the file, and has no defining lemma: only the derived round-trip `zeroResidueFieldRingEquiv_algebraMap` is provided, so consumers meeting `algebraMap K κ(0) k` must unfold `RingHom.toAlgebra` by hand.

summary: The K-structure on `T₀A` is installed by registering `Module.compHom` as a global instance on a reducible synonym for `Module.Dual κ(0) _`, which Mathlib documents as a non-instance and which already carries a competing `SMul K` from `LinearMap.instSMul`; separately, four public normal-form lemmas advertise an RHS containing a no-op `residueFieldCongr` cast that simp cannot remove, and the new `Algebra K κ(0)` instance is anonymous and has no `algebraMap` characterization.
